issues: Per-level XP delta shown on each row is NOT strictly monotonic (L2=800 XP, L3=700 XP, L4=800 XP) because rank 1 is forced to 0 while the curve then rounds to the nearest 100. Cumulative thresholds ARE strictly increasing (spec requirement) and unit tests pass — this is only a cosmetic wobble in the displayed 'XP to reach this level' column and does not violate the bug-fix spec. Optional polish: display cumulative XP instead of delta, or drop the L1 short-circuit so the first delta is 300 rather than 800.

rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration validates a bug FIX. Root cause of the original bug (fixed by main agent) was the flat per-tier XP_TABLE where ranks 26..30 shared identical cumulative thresholds. Fix replaces XP_TABLE with rank_threshold(rank) = tier_start_xp + 10000*(tier_progress^1.6) rounded to nearest 100, guaranteeing strictly increasing cumulative thresholds with exact milestone landings at R10=10k, R20=20k, R30=30k, R40=40k, R50=50k. Unlocks are now persisted in user.unlocked_abilities via _sync_unlocked_abilities() which is additive/idempotent and includes the equipped ability, so a lowered post-recompute rank cannot revoke previously earned abilities.
